# Laravel imgproxy - LLM Context (v2)

## Project Overview

**imsus/laravel-imgproxy** v2 is a ground-up rewrite of the Laravel package for [imgproxy](https://imgproxy.net/) integration. It generates signed, processed image URLs with an immutable fluent builder, renders responsive `<img>` and `<picture>` tags with LQIP placeholders, and builds sources from Storage disks.

## Requirements

- PHP ^8.4
- Laravel 13
- An imgproxy server (v4 recommended; option segments target the v4 processing docs)

## Key Features

- Immutable fluent URL builder with one typed method per imgproxy v4 processing option
- HMAC-SHA256 URL signing with `signature_size` truncation
- URL-safe base64 source encoding by default (plain encoding opt-out)
- Multi-instance manager: default plus named instances, each with its own URL, credentials, signature size, and encoding
- Named presets in config, composable from the builder and the Blade components
- LQIP placeholder helper (`->placeholder()`) for blur-up previews
- Typed PHP 8.4+ enums: `ResizeType`, `Gravity`, `Format`, `WatermarkPosition`
- Responsive Blade components: `<x-imgproxy-img>` and `<x-imgproxy-picture>`
- Storage integration: `Storage::disk(...)->imgproxy($path)` macro
- Artisan commands: `imgproxy:key`, `imgproxy:health`
- 100% Pest type coverage enforced; golden-vector signing tests

## Core API Names

- **`Imgproxy` facade** (`Imsus\LaravelImgproxy\Imgproxy`) — proxies to the Manager
- **`imgproxy()` helper** — returns the Manager instance
- **`Manager`** — resolves imgproxy instances from config
- **`Builder`** — immutable fluent URL builder (53 public methods)
- **`Enums`** — `ResizeType`, `Gravity`, `Format`, `WatermarkPosition`
- **Blade components** — `<x-imgproxy-img>`, `<x-imgproxy-picture>`
- **Storage macro** — `FilesystemAdapter::imgproxy(string $path, int|DateTimeInterface|null $expiration = null): Builder`
- **Artisan commands** — `imgproxy:key`, `imgproxy:health --instance=`

## Builder Method Groups

| Group | Methods |
| --- | ---|
| Construction & terminal | `__construct`, `url`, `__toString`, `encoding`, `disk` |
| Resize | `resize`, `size`, `resizingType`, `width`, `height`, `minWidth`, `minHeight`, `zoom` |
| Crop & gravity | `crop`, `trim`, `padding`, `gravity`, `focusPoint` |
| Quality & format | `quality`, `format`, `formatQuality`, `skipProcessing`, `rawResponse` |
| Effects | `blur`, `sharpen`, `pixelate`, `dpr`, `placeholder` |
| Transform | `rotate`, `autoRotate`, `flip`, `enlarge`, `extend`, `extendAspectRatio` |
| Background & watermark | `background`, `watermark` |
| Output | `stripMetadata`, `keepCopyright`, `stripColorProfile`, `preserveHdr`, `enforceThumbnail`, `returnAttachment`, `cacheBuster`, `expires`, `filename`, `imgproxyPreset` |
| Security | `maxSrcResolution`, `maxSrcFileSize`, `maxAnimationFrames`, `maxAnimationFrameResolution`, `maxResultDimension` |
| Escape hatch | `raw` |
| Presets | `preset` |

## Usage Pattern

```php
use Imsus\LaravelImgproxy\Imgproxy;
use Imsus\LaravelImgproxy\Enums\ResizeType;
use Imsus\LaravelImgproxy\Enums\Format;

$url = Imgproxy::url('https://example.com/image.jpg')
    ->resize(ResizeType::Fill, 300, 300)
    ->quality(80)
    ->format(Format::Webp)
    ->url();

// Helper is equivalent:
$url = imgproxy()->url('https://example.com/image.jpg')->width(640)->url();
```

## Configuration

```php
config('laravel-imgproxy') = [
    'default' => 'default',
    'instances' => [
        'default' => [
            'url' => env('IMGPROXY_URL'),
            'key' => env('IMGPROXY_KEY'),
            'salt' => env('IMGPROXY_SALT'),
            'signature_size' => null,
            'encoding' => 'base64',
        ],
    ],
    'presets' => [],
];
```

## Development Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `composer install` | Install dependencies |
| `composer test` | Full validation: analyse + lint:check + test:types + test:unit |
| `composer lint:check` | Check code style (Pint dry-run) |
| `composer lint` | Auto-fix code style (Pint) |
| `composer analyse` | Static analysis (PHPStan + Larastan) |
| `composer test:types` | Type coverage (100% enforced) |
| `composer test:unit` | Unit tests (Pest 5) |
| `composer build` | Build the workbench playground |
| `composer serve` | Build and serve the workbench playground |

## Code Conventions

- PHP 8.4+ required, strict types declared
- All classes use `Imsus\LaravelImgproxy` namespace
- Builder is immutable: every option method returns a new instance
- Enums accept instances or string backing values interchangeably
- `InvalidArgumentException` for invalid inputs
